responsibility: Implements the LoongArch hooks used by GCC’s D front end. It registers D builtin version identifiers that describe the active LoongArch word size and float ABI, and provides getTargetInfo handling for target traits such as "floatAbi", returning front-end-visible strings derived from the resolved backend configuration.
same_name_distinction: Unlike loongarch-d.h, this source file provides the actual D front-end target-hook implementations, computing builtin version identifiers and getTargetInfo responses from the resolved LoongArch backend configuration rather than just declaring and wiring those hooks through macros.
